description: Return GitLab repository file metadata without downloading file content.

file_path.description: Repository-relative path to the file. URL-encoding is handled automatically.
file_path.title: File Path

project_id.description: The numeric project ID or namespace/project path. URL-encoding is handled automatically.
project_id.title: Project Id

ref.description: Branch, tag, commit SHA, or HEAD containing the file.
ref.title: Ref

name: get_repository_file_metadata

commit_id.description: Commit SHA for the requested file ref.
commit_id.title: Commit Id

content_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the file content. Omitted by some GitLab versions.
content_sha256.title: Content Sha256

encoding.description: Encoding used for the file content.
encoding.title: Encoding

execute_filemode.description: Whether the executable file mode is set. Omitted by some GitLab versions.
execute_filemode.title: Execute Filemode

file_path.description: Full repository-relative path to the file.
file_path.title: File Path

last_commit_id.description: SHA of the last commit that modified the file.
last_commit_id.title: Last Commit Id

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit ref used by GitLab.
ref.title: Ref

size.description: Size of the raw Git blob in bytes.
size.title: Size
